steps.content:
**I'd go with Brackmoor Sound (seller B), but only by a small margin.**

The two listings match on almost everything:

| | Ottervale Audio (A) | Brackmoor Sound (B) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Rating | 4.3 (210 reviews) | 4.3 (210 reviews) |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Specs and box contents | Same | Same |

**Why B:** Brackmoor says it is an "Authorized Quellwyn dealer" with "Full manufacturer warranty." Ottervale makes no such claim. Authorized-dealer status usually means the product is genuine and new, and that the manufacturer will honor the warranty. With Ottervale you can't tell from the listing whether it's an authorized reseller. That matters if you ever need a warranty claim.

**Caveats:**
- Both list the same "1-year limited warranty," so the practical difference may be small. Ottervale's warranty could be perfectly fine too. It just isn't stated.
- The identical rating and review count suggest the reviews may be for the product overall, not for each seller. They don't tell you which seller is better.
- I only have the listing pages. I couldn't check seller reputation, and the authorized-dealer claim is the seller's own statement. If you want to be sure, check Quellwyn's website for its list of authorized retailers.

With the same price, shipping and return terms, the stated authorized-dealer status is the only real tiebreaker, and it favors Brackmoor Sound.
